payload.body_they: {{Name}} can be completely capable of doing something and still spend too much time trying to become ready for the beginning. They revise, prepare, learn more, and try to remove uncertainty before anyone else has had a chance to respond. Preparation often improves the result, which makes the cost easy to miss. Preparation should make it easier for them to begin, not keep moving the beginning further away.
